name: Story of Alicia
summary:
Story of Alicia is a fan-made revival project based on 말과 나의 이야기, 앨리샤 (Story of My Horse and Me, Alicia), the horse racing and ranch management game developed by Ntreev Soft. Created as a private server, Story of Alicia seeks to faithfully recreate and expand upon the experience of the original title, which was discontinued in 2014.

The project is built around community-driven development, with a focus on consistent updates, gameplay improvements, and player feedback. While still in active development, Story of Alicia will be fully free-to-play upon release, allowing both returning fans and new players to experience the world of Alicia once again.

Story of Alicia is an independent, non-commercial project and is not affiliated with Ntreev Soft.
